name: ai-islands
description: AI Islands — a visual AI-agent workspace

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @ai-islands/server && npm run build -w @ai-islands/web
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @ai-islands/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @ai-islands/server && npm run typecheck -w @ai-islands/web
